solution.what: 862.20223 is not among the scanned M973 frames; only the purport list (roll 207 frames 1008-1014) is online. No ciphertext reachable.
Web search on Lima/Perl/Room 40 1917 and on the file number 862.20223: no edition, decipherment or mention. FRUS 1917 Supp. and UK HW 7/ADM 137 not searched.

NARA bulk sweep slice J found the file scanned: M336 roll 64 (naId 574876562), frames c. 0048-0207. OCR shows 5-figure German code groups relayed by the US Legation, a Quito-Lima letter code (f.0104), London replies with substance (f.0207 verbatim) and two of one batch of six called undecipherable (f.0101). Not yet transcribed.

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: the file is not scanned. Next: NARA College Park request, UK Room 40 decrypts, FRUS 1917.
